entries.desc: A CLAUDE.md fixture that references a path which does not exist on disk and has no source-literal reference makes the docs-drift gate return status fail with a missing-path entry naming the path

evidence.note: Happy case: md references a non-existent path (pathExists=false, grep=false) -> runDocsDriftGate with repoRoot returns status fail and names the path in missingPaths; summary includes the path.

entries.desc: A CLAUDE.md fixture whose referenced paths all exist (or are found via grep fallback) returns status pass; allowlisted intentional/deleted-by-design paths are not reported

evidence.note: Edge case: a referenced path that exists (pathExists=true) -> status pass, missingPaths empty; also covers grep-fallback (pathExists=false but grepLiteral=true) staying pass.

entries.desc: A path inside docs/story/ or a template placeholder (uppercase XXX) in the fixture is NOT reported as drift (existing scanPathDrift noise controls preserved); the command-name scan result for the same fixture is byte-identical to before

evidence.note: Adversarial: docs/story/ path + uppercase-XXX placeholder + allowlisted path are NOT flagged; and command-name missing/stale result is byte-identical with vs without repoRoot (unregistered command still caught), proving the path check is purely additive.

entries.desc: A CLAUDE.md fixture that says do-not-create / must-not-exist for a path the managed-asset registry generates (a generated kind) makes the gate return status fail with a managed-asset-contradiction entry naming the asset and the registry definition that contradicts it

evidence.note: happy: injected codex-hooks generated def + md forbidding it → runDocsDriftGate status fail, asset+kind in managedAssetContradictions; smoke green

entries.desc: A fixture that forbids a path the registry classifies as NON-generated (excluded-path / remove-extra) does NOT trigger a contradiction; a fixture with no do-not-create claims passes

evidence.note: edge: md forbidding an excluded-path (NON-generated) kind → no contradiction/pass; md with no do-not-create claim → pass; ancestor-dir prohibition of a generated child → flagged; smoke green

entries.desc: A do-not-create claim for a generated asset that is present in the allowlist seam is NOT flagged (lets the real CLAUDE.md pending Codex-hooks claim pass until B-94ae); the check reads the registry rather than a hardcoded path list, proven by a fixture registry-provider injection

evidence.note: adversarial: allowlisted pending Codex-hooks claim NOT flagged (real CLAUDE.md self-check pass); flipping injected def kind generated→excluded flips outcome (proves registry-driven, not hardcoded); absent defs → empty contradictions; smoke green

entries.desc: Running the new docs-drift smoke (node dist/tasks/<name>-smoke.js) exits 0 and prints a passed line, asserting (a) stale-path fixture fails, (b) managed-asset-contradiction fixture fails, (c) clean fixture passes, (d) command-name behavior unchanged

evidence.note: Compiled smoke runs all four behaviors (stale-path fail, managed-asset contradiction fail, clean pass, command-name unchanged) and prints "docs-drift path+asset smoke passed" with exit 0.

entries.desc: The smoke uses dependency-injected fixtures (in-memory md strings + injected pathExists/grep/registry providers) and never reads or mutates the real CLAUDE.md

evidence.note: DI-fixture logic tests assert edge behaviors: clean fixture yields empty missingPaths AND empty managedAssetContradictions; injected pathExists/grepLiteral/managedAssetDefs only, real CLAUDE.md never read.

entries.desc: The smoke is wired into the actual lattice validate battery (chained into root npm test) so REVIEW->TEST runs it; running npm test shows the smoke output line and a deliberately broken check makes npm test fail

evidence.note: Smoke is chained into root npm test (= lattice validate battery): test:main-write-lock-coverage && test:docs-drift-smoke && test:e2e. Observed output line "docs-drift path+asset smoke passed" during npm test, then "✓ ALL PASS". Negative control: breaking one assert in dist yields non-zero exit.
